description:
Closing line value (CLV) over one wallet's large trades in a window: the trades get_large_trades_history returns for the same trader, from, to, min_size and category, each measured as its clv object is. CLV is cents per share against the market's stored close (get_market_close): a buy scores the close minus the price paid, a sell the price received minus the close, so positive beat the close. Only trades filled before kickoff on a market with a measured close count; the rest are counted in excluded (in_play, pending, unavailable). Gross of fees. Large trades only, not every fill. The window defaults to the 90 days before to (default now), at most 366 days; a window over 25,000 large trades is refused.

Args:
  - address (string, required): Wallet address (0x...), username, or trd_-prefixed trader id
  - from (string, optional): Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on the trade time; defaults to 90 days before to
  - to (string, optional): Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound; defaults to now
  - min_size (number, optional): Minimum trade size in USD, default 5000
  - category (string, optional): Filter by market category (case-insensitive): a sport such as Basketball, a league such as NBA (it folds into its sport), Esports, or sports for every sport but Esports. Omit it for every sports and esports trade

Returns: id, address, from, to, min_size, category, basis_version, large_trades, measured (trades, markets, size_usd, mean_clv_cents, stake_weighted_clv_cents, share_beat_close, market_mean_clv_cents, market_ci95_cents with low and high over at least two markets), excluded and meta.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), username, or trd_-prefixed trader id

category.description: Filter by market category (case-insensitive): a sport such as Basketball, a league such as NBA (it folds into its sport), Esports, or sports for every sport but Esports. Omit it for every sports and esports trade

from.description: Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on the trade time; defaults to 90 days before to

to.description: Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on the trade time; defaults to now, at most 366 days after from

name: get_trader_clv
title: Get trader closing line value
